source_tool: built-in image_gen; no paid PixelLab generation

side.derivation: front tinted x0.72 (shadow), then requantized to the shared palette

roof.derivation: front tinted x1.22 (lit top), then requantized to the shared palette

usage: TrainingArena.Block/BlockRear tile `front` horizontally across the front rectangle (stretched vertically to each wall's own height) and texture-map `side`/`roof` onto the existing east-face/roof parallelograms (TrainingArena._draw_tiled_quad), replacing the flat grey placeholder color + caption. Applied only to WorldScale.BLOCKS entries with height >= 140 (indices 1, 4, 5, 6 as of this delivery) -- the ones the World Builder's own PlacedObjects.def_of() calls "Wall"; rocks/crates/other blocks are unaffected.
